recognize_zh: 低倍下骨小樑之間的骨髓大多被脂肪取代，造血細胞只在脂肪細胞間形成細網狀、片狀分布，左上區域幾乎全為脂肪與出血；兒童全血球減少合併這種低細胞性、不均勻的造血，是兒童難治性血球減少症常見的切片樣貌。
features: Hypocellular marrow for age with fat cells occupying most of the intertrabecular space
Patchy distribution: residual hematopoiesis in thin interstitial cords, with near-empty fatty/hemorrhagic areas at the upper left
Residual hematopoietic cells include clusters of dark round erythroid precursors and scattered myeloid cells
Few megakaryocytes identified at this magnification
Bony trabeculae unremarkable; no fibrosis, granulomas, or abnormal infiltrate
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, low-medium power) shows an intertrabecular space largely replaced by adipose tissue. Residual hematopoiesis is patchy, forming thin interstitial cords and small foci composed mainly of erythroid precursors with admixed myeloid cells and rare megakaryocytes. There is no increase in blasts, fibrosis, granulomas or infiltrative process. The marrow is hypocellular for an 8-year-old; with pancytopenia, the findings are consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood, pending cytogenetic and constitutional work-up.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows diffuse aplasia with near-absent megakaryocytes and lacks the scattered erythroid islands seen in refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.dx: Fanconi anemia or other inherited marrow failure
ddx.vs: Histology overlaps; chromosome breakage studies and germline genetic testing are required.
Not separable morphologically; flow cytometry for GPI-anchored proteins (FLAER, CD59) identifies PNH clones.
